name: 章ごとの読書の問い
prompt:
Create one clear Japanese chapter-question reading guide using the exact 390 by 660 native preview in reference 2. Keep the page calm and white. Owner preference: no tinted surface colors. Use no pastel fills, colored panels, badges, gradients, or colored shadows. Use near-black #1D1D1D for the title and question text, neutral gray #6E6E6E for chapter labels, and at most one restrained forest-green accent in the heading. The original source screen's all-green text should be simplified to this neutral hierarchy.

Canvas 390 by 660, pure white. One left-aligned column with x16 and width358. Heading 読書の問い at y8, Meiryo Bold 20px with 28px line height, near-black. Arrange eight repeated groups at 78px vertical intervals: chapter label at y56, 134, 212, 290, 368, 446, 524, 602, Meiryo Regular 12px, neutral gray; corresponding question body at y80, 158, 236, 314, 392, 470, 548, 626, Meiryo Regular 12px, near-black. Keep the established spacing and one-line content; use no cards, dividers or tinted row backgrounds.

Preserve exact copy and order: 第4章・陰謀 — 三人はなぜダンテスを憎むのでしょう。; 第12章・父と息子 — 二組の父子の愛と忠誠を比べてみましょう。; 第17章・司祭の部屋 — ファリアとの関係は、彼にどんな変化を与えますか。; 第21章・ティブーレン島 — 島に流れ着いた彼は、入獄前とどう違いますか。; 第25章・見知らぬ人 — ヤコポへの寛大さから、彼の価値観を考えましょう。; 第30章・9月5日 — モレルを助ける行動には、何が働いているのでしょう。; 第34章・コロセウム — 伯爵を吸血鬼と見る夫人の考えをどう読みますか。; 第37章・地下墓地 — アルベールと伯爵の対比から、何が見えてきますか。

Reference 2 controls exact Japanese content, order, canvas, and line spacing. Reference 1 is the original Fable reading-guide screenshot, already viewed; use it only for content hierarchy and do not copy its phone chrome, second page or other app content. Reference 3 confirms the native editable text and dimensions. Add no extra questions, icons, controls, page chrome or colored surfaces.
reviewNotes: Neutral no-tint palette and all eight questions are present; content is shifted below the native anchors and the last row has little bottom margin.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
